report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 76ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This contradicts the checkout error-rate/latency alert and does not support any taxonomy candidate. Only gateway evidence was admitted; downstream services (order, payment, inventory, redis, postgresql) have no observations, so the fault cannot be localized. Handing off for downstream telemetry.
